project.name: QSign Translator
project.description: Public read-only context for a transparent RU/KZ/EN sign-language draft-planning prototype.

policy.includes: Published project context, methodology, and source-registry entries.
policy.excludes: Translation jobs, review data, uploads, tokens, sessions, private media, and every mutation endpoint.
policy.citation_policy: Cite the returned public URL and preserve QSign's non-certified-interpreter and human-review limitations.
policy.unknown_policy: State that the public source does not establish the fact; do not infer a translation, signer validation, or source license.

resources.purpose: Published product scope, safety limits, pages, and machine-readable links.
Published source registry and license/access notes.

tasks.title: Explain QSign's published scope and limits
steps: State the prototype and human-review limits.
tasks.empty_behavior: Report that public project context is unavailable.
tasks.degraded_behavior: Use only an available public context resource and name the missing one.
tasks.out_of_scope: Do not produce a certified interpretation or disclose private review material.

tasks.title: Find published source-registry entries
user_intents: What public sources does QSign list?
tasks.empty_behavior: Say that no matching public source-registry entry was returned.
tasks.degraded_behavior: Do not substitute an unverified source or an internal record.
tasks.out_of_scope: Do not infer license status beyond the returned record.
